lines.text: Teachers will be judged more strictly, and we all stumble in many ways.
Bits in the mouths of mules guide the whole animal, and a very small rudder steers large ships.
The tongue is a small part of the body, yet it is a fire that pollutes the whole person.
No man can tame the tongue, yet with it we bless our Lord and Father and curse men.
Fresh water and salt water cannot flow from the same spring, and a fig tree cannot grow pomegranates.
